alignment_target: IPST / สสวท-style Thai primary mathematics
scope_note: Created as best-effort Singapore Math-aligned curriculum for Thai primary schools. Not an official IPST/สสวท publication. Requires review by qualified Thai math educators before use in production.
design_principles: CPA Approach: Concrete → Pictorial → Abstract progression in every topic
Bar Modeling for all word problems
Number Bonds as foundational tool for all operations
Place Value understanding before procedural algorithms
Mental Math and flexible strategies prioritized
Fewer topics, deeper mastery per grade
Real-life Thai context for all word problems
